Triage: graded `pm:on-hold` / `domain:devx` / Task — decision made: not now. The collision class is real but measured LATENT (baseline: 1 entry, 0 anonymous-fn entries, 0 files with more than one entry), and the repair direction is genuinely contested — importing a naming vocabulary into a gate that has none, versus letting undefined mean undeclarable as the sibling call site already does — so a dispatch today buys nothing and risks minting the wrong shape.

Restart-when: `node -e "const b=require('./scripts/durability-read-invention.baseline.json');process.exit(b.entries.filter(e=>!e.fn).length?1:0)"` exits non-zero (an anonymous-fn entry has appeared in the baseline), or any single file comes to carry more than one baseline entry.
Restart-touch: scripts/durability-read-invention.baseline.json

On restart, the reviving seat picks the repair direction against the then-current entry, not from this card's guesses.

This card is one of the four open improvement cards on that one gate and closes with the ruling — ⛔ not a verdict on its reading, which stands. If a real incident (silent data loss reaching a user) is ever traced to the gap this card describes, that incident is the card to file.
